body.message:
And I didn’t notice on the first day that the card wasn’t there because I simply didn’t need it or have any reason to use it.
Even if the card had actually been lost, AED 500 is not the cost of replacing a parking access card. Charging this amount for something you failed to provide in the first place feels like a modern form of theft.
This is completely unfair. I hope God forgives you for treating your customers this way.
